title: vektor /// no. 035 — MCP doesn't replace your API
description: Everyone thinks MCP is a new kind of API. It isn't — the model never makes the call, and the protocol just deprecated the one feature that went around your API. The diagram, the arithmetic, and every line of the spec it rests on, quoted and linked. As promised.
